subject: CycleHealth renewal & QBR: timeline, capacity uplift, and next steps
messages:
From: Elena Parkel <eparkel@cyclehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CycleHealth renewal: timeline & capacity ask

Hi Michael & Marissa,

Thanks again for the great demo last week. CycleHealth's usage has grown faster than we expected after the pilot — attached is our Q3 usage export so you have the run rate (CH_usage_report_Q3.csv). We expect sustained 2.5x token growth starting Jan and would like to lock a renewal that:

- Extends through Dec 2026 (one-year term)
- Adds a burst pool for seasonal peaks (+3 GPUs equivalent)
- Preserves data residency controls in us-west region

Two asks to start the kickoff: can we (1) schedule a brief QBR to align timelines and stakeholders, and (2) start a mutual action plan so procurement & legal can see milestones?

Prefer week of Nov 17 for the QBR. Attendees likely: me, David O'Neill (Procurement), their infra lead (TBD), plus Redwood AM/CS/Eng as needed.

Elena
Elena Parkel
Head of Platform Partnerships
CycleHealth

Attachment: CH_usage_report_Q3.csv (summary export)
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Elena Parkel <eparkel@cyclehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-14T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CycleHealth renewal: timeline & capacity ask

Thanks Elena — appreciate the usage file, that's helpful. High level reply and proposed next steps:

1) QBR slots: I'm available Tue Nov 18 10:00-11:00 PT or Thu Nov 20 14:00-15:00 PT. I've attached a .ics with both options (Proposed_QBR_slots.ics). Please pick what works for your execs and procurement.

2) MAP (mutual action plan): Karthik, can you pull a MAP template? I attached a one-page starter we use for capacity/term renewals (MAP_v1_CycleHealth.pdf).

3) Capacity sketch: based on the run rate Elena sent, we can propose a staircase commit with a baseline + burst pool to cover the 2.5x growth window. We'll need an initial sizing call with your infra lead to confirm KV-cache patterns and peak concurrency.

4) Procurement: Marissa, tagging you for SOW and DocuSign cadence. Karthik, please include pricing ranges for baseline vs burst and an uplift path (N+1, N+3).

I'll host the QBR and bring engineering for the capacity runbook. If Nov 20 works, I'll send a calendar invite and a 20-minute agenda.

Best,
Michael Grant
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_v1_CycleHealth.pdf, Proposed_QBR_slots.ics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Parkel <eparkel@cyclehealth.com>, David O'Neill <david.oneill@cyclehealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-15T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CycleHealth renewal: timeline & capacity ask

Looping in procurement and legal points of contact on our side and confirming internal owners:

- Marissa (AM) — lead for SOW and QBR facilitation
- Karthik (Solutions) — build capacity runbook and pricing variants
- Michael (AE) — exec alignment and calendar

Internal asks (short):
- Karthik: draft two pricing scenarios (baseline + burst vs committed stair-step) by EOD Nov 18 so we have numbers for the QBR.
- Michael: confirm preferred QBR slot and agenda; I'll prep a short SOW template for procurement.

External asks to CycleHealth: please confirm the infra attendee and whether the burst pool needs GPU type preference (A100 vs H100). Also share procurement lead contact for DocuSign routing (David, adding you here).

I'll prepare a one-page SOW skeleton and share before the QBR.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: David O'Neill <david.oneill@cyclehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Parkel <eparkel@cyclehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-18T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CycleHealth renewal: timeline & capacity ask

Hi all — thanks for pulling this together. Procurement timeline: we need review window with legal (5 business days) and internal budget approval (7 business days). Targeting signature by Dec 5 if we start this week.

QBR: Nov 20 14:00-15:00 PT works for me. Please send an agenda and include a short procurement slide listing: SOW summary, billing cadence, termination language, and data residency confirmation.

I've attached our preferred SOW template and a draft statement-of-work for Redwood to review (CycleHealth_SOW_draft.docx). Once we finalize, we'll route via DocuSign.

David O'Neill
Director, Procurement
CycleHealth

Attachment: CycleHealth_SOW_draft.docx
